guide: Associate Cloud Engineer exam guide, live from 2026-06-30

entries.title: Org-wide control that covers future projects
entries.summary: IAM and org policy are inherited downward, so binding at the organisation node covers all current and future descendants.

entries.title: Departmental access boundary
entries.summary: A folder is the inheritance boundary for a department: bind once, and every current and future child project inherits.

entries.title: Isolating regulated workloads
entries.summary: A dedicated folder gives regulated projects a single inheritance point and makes the compliance boundary explicit.

entries.title: Sandbox exception that must not leak
entries.summary: The project is the narrowest scope that still carries IAM and org policy, so an exception there cannot leak upward or sideways.

entries.title: Access to exactly one bucket
entries.summary: IAM can bind directly on individual resources such as buckets — the only scope that exposes one bucket without the project.

entries.title: Organisation-wide asset visibility for auditors
entries.summary: Only an organisation-node binding gives visibility across all folders and projects, including ones created later.

entries.title: Block public IPs except on a bastion
entries.summary: compute.vmExternalIpAccess is a list constraint: deny by default, allow-list the bastion.

entries.title: Keep external identities out of IAM policies
entries.summary: iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains rejects policy members outside the listed customer IDs at write time.

entries.title: Force teams off downloadable keys
entries.summary: iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation removes the ability to mint downloadable keys org-wide.

entries.title: Enforce EU data residency
entries.summary: gcp.resourceLocations restricts the locations in which resources may be created.

entries.title: Require Shielded VM on every instance
entries.summary: compute.requireShieldedVm makes instance creation fail unless Shielded VM protections are on.

entries.title: Prevent public buckets organisation-wide
entries.summary: storage.publicAccessPrevention blocks allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers grants for its whole scope.

entries.title: Link projects without seeing spend
entries.summary: Billing Account User is exactly the link-projects permission, with no read access to cost data.

entries.title: Read-only cost reporting
entries.summary: Billing Account Viewer is read-only across the billing account, its cost data and its budgets.

entries.title: Move a project between billing accounts
entries.summary: Project Billing Manager is scoped to the project and controls only the project-to-billing-account association.

entries.title: Subsidiary opens its own billing account
entries.summary: Billing Account Creator at the org node permits creating new billing accounts and nothing more.

entries.title: Full ownership of a billing account
entries.summary: Billing Account Administrator is the full-control role covering users, budgets and project linkage.

entries.title: Threshold alerts at 50/90/100 percent
entries.summary: A budget scoped to the project with multiple threshold rules emails the billing recipients.

entries.title: Automatically stop a sandbox over budget
entries.summary: Budget notifications on Pub/Sub can trigger a function that calls the Compute Engine API.

entries.title: Alert on forecast rather than actual spend
entries.summary: Budgets support a forecasted-spend threshold basis, firing on the projected total.

entries.title: Chargeback model per business unit
entries.summary: Detailed billing export to BigQuery is the only source with per-SKU, per-resource rows carrying labels.

entries.title: Attribute costs inside one shared project
entries.summary: Labels applied to resources flow into billing data, enabling per-team grouping.

entries.title: Active Directory as the source of truth
entries.summary: GCDS reads AD/LDAP on a schedule and creates, updates and suspends the matching Cloud Identity users and groups.

entries.title: No second password for Google Cloud
entries.summary: SAML SSO delegates authentication to the existing IdP, so no separate Google password exists.

entries.title: Thousands of contractors without accounts
entries.summary: Workforce Identity Federation grants access to external workforce identities with no per-user account.

entries.title: Offboarding must revoke cloud access automatically
entries.summary: Directory Sync suspends accounts whose source records disappear, so AD offboarding propagates.

entries.title: Employees signed up with company email
entries.summary: The transfer tool brings unmanaged consumer accounts under organisational control.

entries.title: API not enabled on a new project
entries.summary: New projects have most APIs disabled; enable the named service on the project.

entries.title: Regional CPU limit reached at peak
entries.summary: Regional CPU limits are quotas; request an increase for that quota in that region.

entries.title: Intermittent 429s during short spikes
entries.summary: Rate-limit errors on brief spikes call for exponential backoff, not more quota.

entries.title: Permission denied with API enabled
entries.summary: With the service enabled and quota available, the remaining cause is a missing IAM binding.

entries.title: Pipeline prerequisite for a fresh project
entries.summary: Service enablement is an idempotent prerequisite that belongs at the start of the pipeline.

entries.title: Survive one data centre failure
entries.summary: Zones are independent failure domains inside a region; a regional MIG spreads instances across them.

entries.title: Survive the loss of a whole region
entries.summary: Only a deployment spanning more than one region survives a regional outage.

entries.title: Confirm a machine family exists in a new country
entries.summary: Product and machine-type availability varies by region and zone and must be verified first.

entries.title: Latency for users on two continents
entries.summary: Serving each population from a nearby region removes the transatlantic round trip.

entries.title: Disposable batch experiment
entries.summary: When work is disposable and re-runnable, single-zone placement avoids paying for redundancy.

entries.title: Find every VM with an external IP now
entries.subtopic: Asset Inventory and Gemini Cloud Assist
entries.summary: Asset search queries live resource metadata org-wide in one call.

entries.title: Two years of monthly configuration snapshots
entries.subtopic: Asset Inventory and Gemini Cloud Assist
entries.summary: Asset snapshot export to BigQuery produces the durable, queryable historical record.

entries.title: Detect an open firewall rule within seconds
entries.subtopic: Asset Inventory and Gemini Cloud Assist
entries.summary: A real-time asset feed publishes each asset change to Pub/Sub as it happens.

entries.title: Who deleted the VM yesterday
entries.summary: Who did what and when is an admin activity audit log question.

entries.title: Locate a bucket by partial name
entries.subtopic: Asset Inventory and Gemini Cloud Assist
entries.summary: Asset search matches resources by name fragment across the organisation.

entries.title: Centralise logs from every project
entries.summary: An aggregated sink at the org or folder node routes descendants' logs to one destination.

entries.title: Guest metrics missing from Monitoring
entries.summary: Guest-level metrics require an in-guest agent; the hypervisor cannot see them.

entries.title: Console access for an external workforce
entries.summary: A workforce pool federates human identities for interactive Google Cloud access.

entries.title: Legacy app needing kernel-level control
entries.summary: Only Compute Engine gives OS-level control; managed container platforms abstract the kernel away.

entries.title: Forty interdependent microservices
entries.summary: A fleet of interdependent services with shared lifecycle policy is what Kubernetes orchestration exists for.

entries.title: Spiky stateless API with no cluster to run
entries.summary: Cloud Run autoscales a container on request concurrency and scales to zero with no cluster.

entries.title: Small handler with no container pipeline
entries.summary: Cloud Run functions deploy from source with an event trigger and no container tooling.

entries.title: No paying for idle capacity
entries.summary: Scale-to-zero billing means you are charged only while a request is served.

entries.title: Reuse existing Helm charts
entries.summary: GKE runs the same Kubernetes API, so existing manifests and Helm charts carry over unchanged.

entries.title: Custom machine shape on Spot capacity
entries.summary: Custom machine types and Spot provisioning are Compute Engine features.

entries.title: Nightly two-hour batch at lowest cost
entries.summary: Interruption-tolerant batch on Spot VMs is the cheapest compute on Google Cloud.

entries.title: Lift-and-shift MySQL, one region
entries.summary: Cloud SQL is drop-in managed MySQL covering this size and throughput with no application change.

entries.title: Globally consistent payments ledger
entries.summary: Spanner alone combines relational semantics, external consistency and multi-region synchronous replication.

entries.title: Ad-hoc SQL over 900 TB of clickstream
entries.summary: BigQuery separates storage from compute and scans petabytes with no provisioned servers.

entries.title: Two million sensor writes per second
entries.summary: Bigtable is built for very high sustained writes and low-latency lookups on a composite row key.

entries.title: Mobile app that works offline
entries.summary: Firestore's client SDKs provide real-time listeners and offline persistence natively.

entries.title: Cache computed sessions sub-millisecond
entries.summary: Memorystore provides managed Redis with sub-millisecond in-memory reads as a cache tier.

entries.title: PostgreSQL with heavy analytical queries
entries.summary: AlloyDB adds a columnar engine on top of PostgreSQL compatibility for mixed workloads.

entries.title: Outgrown the largest Cloud SQL machine
entries.summary: Spanner scales writes horizontally while preserving relational semantics, removing app-level sharding.

entries.title: Images served to a public website
entries.summary: With frequent reads, Standard's lack of retrieval fees makes it cheapest overall.

entries.title: Monthly reporting extracts kept two years
entries.summary: A once-a-month read pattern fits Nearline's 30-day minimum and per-read fee.

entries.title: Quarterly audit evidence, instant retrieval
entries.summary: Coldline's 90-day minimum matches quarterly access and still returns objects immediately.

entries.title: Seven years of regulatory records
entries.summary: For data that may never be read, Archive's storage price dominates total cost.

entries.title: Nightly backups restored monthly
entries.summary: Monthly restores and 90-day retention fit Nearline's minimum duration exactly.

entries.title: Path routing with managed TLS worldwide
entries.summary: Path routing, managed TLS and a global anycast IP are properties of the global external ALB.

entries.title: UDP game server preserving client IP
entries.summary: Passthrough load balancing forwards packets unproxied, supporting UDP and preserving source IP.

entries.title: Internal HTTPS with host-based routing
entries.summary: The internal ALB provides layer 7 routing on a private VPC address.

entries.title: Insert third-party firewall appliances
entries.summary: The internal passthrough NLB is the supported next hop for appliance insertion.

entries.title: TLS offload for a non-HTTP TCP service
entries.summary: The external proxy NLB terminates TLS at the edge for arbitrary TCP protocols.

entries.title: Cloud CDN and Cloud Armor in front of an app
entries.summary: Cloud CDN and Cloud Armor attach to the external ALB's backend services and edge.

entries.title: Central network team, many app projects
entries.summary: Shared VPC separates network ownership (host project) from workload ownership (service projects).

entries.title: Private traffic between two organisations
entries.summary: VPC Peering connects networks across organisations over Google's backbone with no gateway.

entries.title: Address plan must match on-premises
entries.summary: Custom-mode VPCs let you choose every subnet range and region deliberately.

entries.title: Peering is not transitive
entries.summary: Peering is explicitly non-transitive; C must peer directly with A.

entries.title: Cross-project private communication without a mesh
entries.summary: Service projects share the host network directly, so no peering mesh is needed.

entries.title: Tier-to-tier rule in a shared subnet
entries.subtopic: Secure Tags and Service Accounts in Rules
entries.summary: Scoping by service account or tag expresses tier-to-tier intent independently of IP addressing.

entries.title: All backends unhealthy behind a new LB
entries.summary: Health check probes come from Google's dedicated ranges and must be explicitly allowed.

entries.title: SSH to VMs with no external IP
entries.summary: IAP TCP forwarding tunnels SSH through Google's frontend from a fixed source range.

entries.title: Restrict outbound to an approved mirror
entries.summary: The implied egress allow is priority 65535, so a lower-numbered deny plus a narrow allow yields default-deny.

entries.title: RDP to the internet must be impossible
entries.summary: Hierarchical policies evaluate before VPC rules and cannot be overridden at project level.

entries.title: Rules that survive autoscaling
entries.subtopic: Secure Tags and Service Accounts in Rules
entries.summary: Tags and service accounts follow the instance template, so rules survive instance replacement.

entries.title: Kubernetes without managing nodes
entries.summary: Autopilot is fully managed GKE: Google runs the nodes and bills per Pod request.

entries.title: Control plane must survive a zone loss
entries.summary: Only a regional cluster replicates the control plane across three zones.

entries.title: No public IPs on nodes
entries.summary: Private nodes plus authorised networks removes public addressing and restricts the endpoint.

entries.title: GPUs for one workload only
entries.summary: A tainted GPU node pool confines expensive hardware to workloads that tolerate the taint.

entries.title: Security defaults that cannot be disabled
entries.summary: Autopilot enables and enforces these defaults as part of the managed mode.

entries.title: Zero-RPO failover for one database VM
entries.summary: Regional PD replicates writes synchronously to a second zone and can be force-attached there.

entries.title: Scratch space rebuilt every run
entries.summary: Local SSD offers the lowest latency and highest IOPS; its ephemerality is acceptable here.

entries.title: Forty VMs sharing one directory tree
entries.summary: Filestore is managed NFS; shared POSIX access from many clients is impossible on a block device.

entries.title: 300,000 IOPS without over-buying capacity
entries.summary: Hyperdisk decouples provisioned IOPS and throughput from capacity.

entries.title: Cheapest durable boot disk for a stateless VM
entries.summary: Because the instance is disposable, a zonal PD avoids paying for cross-zone replication.

entries.title: Traffic triples every weekday morning
entries.summary: The MIG autoscaler adds and removes instances against a target metric.

entries.title: VM alive but application hung
entries.summary: Autohealing detects a live VM with a dead application and recreates the instance.

entries.title: Patch 30 instances without losing capacity
entries.summary: A rolling update with maxSurge creates replacements before removing old instances.

entries.title: Serving tier spans zones automatically
entries.summary: A regional MIG distributes instances across zones and redistributes after a zonal failure.

entries.title: Canary a version to 10 percent
entries.summary: A canary rollout is a second version on the MIG with a percentage target size.

entries.title: Branch office connected this week
entries.summary: HA VPN provisions in minutes, encrypts with IPsec, and needs no physical circuit.

entries.title: 20 Gbps with predictable latency
entries.summary: Dedicated Interconnect provides 10/100 Gbps circuits with deterministic performance.

entries.title: 1 Gbps without colocation presence
entries.summary: Partner Interconnect bridges the last mile through a service provider at sub-10 Gbps.

entries.title: Encrypted backup path for an Interconnect
entries.summary: HA VPN over the internet is the standard Interconnect failover, arbitrated by Cloud Router BGP priorities.

entries.title: Reviewable multi-environment infrastructure
entries.summary: Terraform with remote state is the standard declarative multi-environment workflow.

entries.title: Provision cloud resources via kubectl
entries.summary: Config Connector exposes Google Cloud resources as Kubernetes CRDs.

entries.title: One app, four clusters, different values
entries.summary: Helm values files parameterise one packaged Kubernetes application per environment.

entries.title: Greenfield landing zone on Terraform
entries.summary: Fabric FAST is Google's opinionated staged Terraform landing-zone framework.

entries.title: Run a container on each new object
entries.summary: Eventarc has a first-class Cloud Storage source delivering finalised events to Cloud Run.

entries.title: React to VM deletions via audit logs
entries.summary: Eventarc can trigger on Cloud Audit Log entries filtered by service and method name.

entries.title: Existing topic to a scale-to-zero service
entries.summary: A push subscription posts each message to the Cloud Run URL, allowing scale from zero.

entries.title: Workers control their own throughput
entries.summary: Pull subscriptions let the consumer set throughput and acknowledgement timing.

entries.title: Nightly reconciliation at 02:00
entries.summary: A fixed daily time is a schedule, not an event; Cloud Scheduler invokes with an OIDC token.

entries.title: Custom CUDA kernels must run unchanged
entries.summary: Custom CUDA is GPU-specific; TPUs use a different programming model entirely.

entries.title: Large JAX model, best price-performance
entries.summary: TPUs are purpose-built for large-scale matrix computation in supported frameworks.

entries.title: Global anycast IP for lowest latency
entries.summary: Global anycast and backbone transit to the nearest edge are Premium Tier features.

entries.title: Large regional egress, cost dominant
entries.summary: Standard Tier egresses locally at a lower price, right for regional latency-tolerant traffic.

entries.title: Accelerators will not fix a serial bottleneck
entries.summary: Accelerators only help parallel numerical work; a serialised query must be fixed in the database.

entries.title: Unbounded user uploads served worldwide
entries.summary: Cloud Storage gives unlimited capacity, HTTPS serving and native lifecycle management.

entries.title: Unmodifiable app needs a POSIX mount
entries.summary: Filestore presents a standard NFS mount for unmodified POSIX applications.

entries.title: SMB shares with snapshots and replication
entries.summary: NetApp Volumes provides managed SMB alongside NFS with enterprise snapshot and replication.

entries.title: HPC scratch at hundreds of GB/s
entries.summary: Managed Lustre is the parallel filesystem built for HPC scratch at that throughput.

entries.title: Two petabytes from another cloud, on a schedule
entries.summary: Storage Transfer Service is the managed, resumable, scheduled cross-cloud transfer service.

entries.title: One-off 40 GB upload from a workstation
entries.summary: The gcloud storage client performs parallel, resumable uploads for one-off transfers.

entries.title: Smoke-test a revision before any traffic
entries.summary: Deploying with --tag and --no-traffic publishes a revision at a dedicated URL.

entries.title: Send 10 percent to the new revision
entries.summary: Cloud Run splits traffic across revisions by percentage.

entries.title: Error rates spike after a release
entries.summary: Previous revisions are retained, so shifting traffic back restores service in seconds.

entries.title: Connection pool exhausted under load
entries.summary: Lowering container concurrency bounds simultaneous requests, and so connections, per instance.

entries.title: Cold starts after idle periods
entries.summary: A minimum instance count keeps containers warm so post-idle requests avoid a cold start.

entries.title: Twelve interchangeable stateless replicas
entries.summary: A Deployment is the controller for interchangeable stateless replicas with native rolling updates.

entries.title: Clustered database needing stable identity
entries.summary: StatefulSets provide ordinal stable names and per-Pod PersistentVolumeClaims.

entries.title: Log agent on every node including new ones
entries.summary: A DaemonSet schedules one Pod per node automatically, including newly added nodes.

entries.title: One-off migration that must retry then stop
entries.summary: A Job runs Pods until a specified number complete successfully, then finishes.

entries.title: Two services, one hostname, path routing
entries.summary: An Ingress or Gateway provisions an external ALB with path rules and managed certificates.

entries.title: Expose a non-HTTP TCP service externally
entries.summary: A Service of type LoadBalancer provisions a layer 4 load balancer for arbitrary TCP.

entries.title: kubectl reports no configured cluster
entries.summary: get-credentials writes the cluster endpoint and auth config into kubeconfig.

entries.title: Pod stuck in Pending
entries.summary: The Events section of describe reports scheduling failures such as insufficient CPU.

entries.title: Stack trace from a crash-looping container
entries.summary: kubectl logs --previous prints output from the terminated container instance.

entries.title: Roll out a patched image to a Deployment
entries.summary: kubectl set image updates the pod template, triggering a native rolling update.

entries.title: Restore the previous Deployment version
entries.summary: kubectl rollout undo re-points the Deployment at its previous ReplicaSet.

entries.title: Pre-provision for a known surge
entries.summary: kubectl scale sets the Deployment replica count directly.

entries.title: ImagePullBackOff on GKE nodes
entries.summary: Image pulls use the node pool's service account, which needs Artifact Registry Reader.

entries.title: Cloud Build cannot push the image
entries.summary: Pushing requires Artifact Registry Writer on the target repository for the build identity.

entries.title: Local docker push rejected as unauthenticated
entries.summary: The Docker client needs the gcloud credential helper registered for the registry host.

entries.title: Destination for images near the cluster
entries.summary: A repository with the right format and location must exist before any push.

entries.title: Registry storage growing without bound
entries.summary: A cleanup policy deletes versions matching age or count rules automatically.

entries.title: Add replicas when CPU exceeds 65 percent
entries.summary: The HorizontalPodAutoscaler scales replica count against a target metric.

entries.title: Pods Pending because the pool is full
entries.summary: Cluster autoscaling adds nodes when Pods cannot schedule and removes underused ones.

entries.title: Requests far higher than real usage
entries.summary: The VerticalPodAutoscaler observes real usage and adjusts requests to match.

entries.title: Controlling Autopilot cost per Pod
entries.summary: Autopilot bills on requested resources, so accurate requests are the direct cost lever.

entries.title: Local SSD cannot be added in place
entries.summary: Node pool hardware properties are fixed at creation, so new hardware means a new pool.

entries.title: Golden hardened base for every new VM
entries.summary: A custom image bakes the configuration into a bootable template.

entries.title: Six-hourly backups retained two weeks
entries.summary: A snapshot schedule resource policy performs and expires snapshots automatically.

entries.title: Safety copy before a risky upgrade
entries.summary: A snapshot captures disk state at that moment and can be restored to a new disk.

entries.title: Specialise a generic image at boot
entries.summary: A startup script in metadata specialises a generic image without rebuilding it.

entries.title: Uniform instances for a managed group
entries.summary: An instance template is the required input to a MIG and fixes those properties.

entries.title: SSH access tied to IAM identities
entries.summary: OS Login binds POSIX accounts to IAM identities, so revoking the role removes SSH access.

entries.title: SSH without public IPs or a bastion
entries.summary: IAP TCP forwarding tunnels SSH through Google's frontend to the internal address.

entries.title: Instance unreachable after a network change
entries.summary: The serial console works independently of the guest network stack.

entries.title: Two-factor on production Linux logins
entries.summary: OS Login supports two-factor authentication as a project or instance setting.

entries.title: RDP to a Windows VM without a public IP
entries.summary: IAP TCP forwarding tunnels arbitrary TCP ports, including RDP's 3389.

entries.title: Build, push and deploy on merge to main
entries.summary: A Cloud Build trigger runs build, push and deploy under a service account inside Google Cloud.

entries.title: Promotion with an approval before production
entries.summary: Cloud Deploy models ordered targets with required approvals between stages.

entries.title: Show reviewers the infrastructure diff
entries.summary: terraform plan produces exactly that diff against current state.

entries.title: Keep source code off laptops
entries.summary: Cloud Workstations provides managed development environments running in your VPC.

entries.title: Memory and disk metrics missing from VMs
entries.summary: Guest-level metrics need an in-guest agent; the hypervisor cannot observe them.

entries.title: Alert on an error string in the logs
entries.summary: A log-based counter metric turns matching entries into a time series an alert can evaluate.

entries.title: Is the site reachable from other continents
entries.summary: Uptime checks probe the endpoint from Google's global checker locations.

entries.title: Keep Prometheus instrumentation without servers
entries.summary: Managed Service for Prometheus scrapes and stores Prometheus metrics as a managed service.

entries.title: Alert on p95 request latency
entries.summary: Cloud Run exports latency as a distribution metric with percentile aligners.

entries.title: SQL investigation across a year of audit logs
entries.summary: Native BigQuery tables of logs, in a dataset you own, come from a log sink; Log Analytics queries logs in place.

entries.title: Seven-year retention at lowest cost
entries.summary: A Cloud Storage sink into an Archive-class bucket is the cheapest compliant destination.

entries.title: Stream logs to an on-premises SIEM
entries.summary: A Pub/Sub sink is the supported streaming egress to an external consumer.

entries.title: 400-day retention queried in place
entries.summary: A log bucket with extended retention and Log Analytics allows SQL queries in place.

entries.title: Reads of table data were never recorded
entries.summary: Admin Activity logs are always on; Data Access logs record reads and must be enabled.

entries.title: Health-check log entries dominate cost
entries.summary: An exclusion filter stops those entries being ingested and billed.

entries.title: Subnet has run out of addresses
entries.summary: A subnet's primary IPv4 range can be expanded in place with no disruption.

entries.title: Partner has firewalled a specific address
entries.summary: Reserving the external address makes it independent of the instance lifecycle.

entries.title: Force traffic through an appliance
entries.summary: A custom static route with the appliance's ILB as next hop overrides the default path.

entries.title: Private hostnames for internal services
entries.summary: A Cloud DNS private managed zone attached to the VPC serves records only to that network.

entries.title: Private instances cannot reach the package mirror
entries.summary: Cloud NAT gives outbound-only internet access to instances with no external address.

entries.title: Who talked to the compromised instance
entries.summary: VPC Flow Logs record connection records with source, destination and port.

entries.title: Age logs to Coldline then delete
entries.summary: Object lifecycle management applies age-based class changes and deletions automatically.

entries.title: Recover an overwritten object
entries.summary: Versioning keeps non-current generations of overwritten and deleted objects.

entries.title: Records nobody can delete for five years
entries.summary: A locked bucket retention policy makes the retention period irreversible.

entries.title: Return to the moment before a bad migration
entries.summary: Point-in-time recovery uses write-ahead logs to restore to a specific timestamp.

entries.title: Recover an accidentally deleted instance
entries.summary: Automated backups are restored into an instance when the original no longer exists.

entries.title: Hand a database copy to an external team
entries.summary: An export writes database contents to Cloud Storage as portable files.

entries.title: Which of six services is slow
entries.summary: Cloud Trace breaks a request into spans per service, attributing end-to-end latency.

entries.title: Which functions burn the CPU
entries.summary: Cloud Profiler samples the running process and attributes CPU and heap to functions.

entries.title: Which queries are loading the database
entries.summary: Query Insights attributes database load to normalised queries and tags their origin.

entries.title: Which VMs are idle or oversized
entries.summary: Active Assist recommenders emit idle-resource and right-sizing recommendations.

entries.title: Deduplicated view of application exceptions
entries.summary: Error Reporting groups stack traces into distinct errors with counts and first-seen times.

entries.title: One view of incidents affecting our projects
entries.summary: Cloud Hub and Personalized Service Health aggregate events and health per project.

entries.title: No predefined role matches exactly
entries.summary: When no predefined role matches, a custom role with exactly those permissions is least privilege.

entries.title: Access expiring at quarter end
entries.summary: IAM conditions express expiry and resource-name predicates on the binding itself.

entries.title: Even Owners must not delete these buckets
entries.summary: Deny policies evaluate before allow policies and cannot be overridden by any role.

entries.title: Google already ships the right role
entries.summary: roles/pubsub.publisher matches exactly; a custom role would duplicate it and need maintenance.

entries.title: Everyone holds Editor in production
entries.summary: Basic roles span every service; replace Editor with the predefined roles each principal actually needs, using role recommendations as evidence.

entries.title: VM calls an API with no key on disk
entries.summary: An attached service account is served short-lived tokens by the metadata server.

entries.title: Pod reaches Cloud Storage without a secret
entries.summary: Workload Identity binds the Kubernetes SA to an IAM SA, issuing short-lived credentials.

entries.title: External CI deploys with no keys allowed
entries.summary: Workload Identity Federation exchanges the provider's OIDC token for short-lived credentials.

entries.title: Privileged action attributable to a person
entries.summary: Impersonation issues a short-lived token while audit logs still record the human principal.

entries.title: Distinguish each app's API calls
entries.summary: A per-application attached service account makes calls individually attributable.

entries.title: One-hour token with no stored secret
entries.summary: Short-lived credential generation via Token Creator yields a time-bounded access token.

entries.title: Disable the key to render data unreadable
entries.summary: CMEK puts key lifecycle under your control, so disabling it makes protected data unreadable.

entries.title: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 key material
entries.summary: The HSM protection level in Cloud KMS meets that certification requirement.

entries.title: Store a database password centrally
entries.summary: Secret Manager stores versioned secret values with per-secret IAM.

entries.title: What must be configured for encryption at rest
entries.summary: All data at rest is encrypted by default; no configuration is needed absent a key-control requirement.

entries.title: Rotate the disk key every 90 days
entries.summary: A Cloud KMS key with a rotation period is a CMEK capability; managed keys expose no schedule.

entries.title: An organisation without a domain for a new Free Trial customer
entries.summary: New Free Trial sign-ups get a standalone organisation automatically; the signing-up user becomes Organization Owner.

entries.title: A second owner for a standalone organisation
entries.summary: Standalone org owners are Google accounts added by invitation they must accept; a service account cannot be an owner.

entries.title: A guided foundation with a Shared VPC host, deployable as Terraform
entries.summary: Google Cloud Setup is the console's guided flow for a new organisation's foundation, including a Shared VPC network.

entries.title: Plain-language questions about your own resources
entries.subtopic: Asset Inventory and Gemini Cloud Assist
entries.summary: Gemini Cloud Assist answers natural-language questions about your resources inside the console, with your permissions.

entries.title: Who can reach this bucket, through groups and inheritance
entries.subtopic: Asset Inventory and Gemini Cloud Assist
entries.summary: Policy Analyzer (Cloud Asset Inventory) expands groups and inherited bindings to answer who has access to a resource.

entries.title: Organisation-wide asset search denied to a project owner
entries.subtopic: Asset Inventory and Gemini Cloud Assist
entries.summary: Searching assets across the organisation needs Cloud Asset Viewer at the organisation node, not project roles.

entries.title: Adding one binding without disturbing the rest
entries.summary: add-iam-policy-binding adds a single binding safely; set-iam-policy replaces the whole policy.

entries.title: Letting a team deploy Cloud Run in one project
entries.summary: Grant the narrow predefined role for the task, to a group, on the one project — not a basic role.

entries.title: A two-year-old account that now wants folders
entries.summary: Standalone organisations are only for new Free Trial customers; an existing customer with a domain uses Cloud Identity.

entries.title: An invitation to a standalone organisation that lapsed
entries.summary: Invitations to a standalone organisation must be accepted within 30 days; after that, invite again.

entries.title: No default network in any new project

entries.summary: The logging query language filters on resource type, labels and severity together.

entries.title: Who made a call, and from which address
entries.summary: An audit log entry's protoPayload carries the caller's principal and IP address.

entries.title: Which index would fix the slow queries
entries.summary: Index advisor in Query Insights recommends indexes for slow queries on Cloud SQL and AlloyDB.

entries.title: Being told when a Google incident affects your projects
entries.summary: Personalized Service Health can alert through Cloud Monitoring on incidents affecting your projects.

entries.title: One application-centric operations view
entries.summary: Cloud Hub gives an app-centric view of active events, health, deployments and maintenance for App Hub apps.

entries.title: AI-assisted root-cause investigation after an alert
entries.summary: Gemini Cloud Assist investigations correlate logs, metrics and recent changes to suggest likely causes.

entries.title: Collecting an application's own log file with the Ops Agent
entries.summary: The Ops Agent reads extra log files when you add a files receiver to its config.yaml and restart it.

entries.title: Scraping an application's /metrics endpoint on GKE
entries.summary: With managed collection, a PodMonitoring resource tells Managed Service for Prometheus which Pods to scrape.

entries.title: Which Pods are using the most memory right now
entries.summary: kubectl top pods shows live CPU and memory use per Pod from the metrics server.

entries.title: Moving a node pool to a bigger machine type
entries.summary: Node machine type is fixed per pool: create a new pool, cordon and drain the old one, then delete it.

entries.title: HPA and VPA fighting over CPU
entries.summary: Do not let HPA and VPA act on the same CPU or memory metric; scale HPA on another metric or run VPA in recommendation mode.

entries.title: Cheaper Autopilot Pods for interruptible work
entries.summary: Autopilot runs Pods on Spot capacity when they select cloud.google.com/gke-spot: "true".

entries.title: Conversation state across turns without building a database
entries.summary: Agent Runtime manages sessions and memory for deployed agents.

entries.title: A notebook instance with no public IP
entries.summary: Workbench instances can be created without a public IP in a subnet that reaches Google APIs privately.

entries.title: Workstations left running overnight
entries.summary: Idle and running timeouts on a workstation configuration stop unused workstations automatically.

entries.title: Source code to a running service in one command
entries.summary: gcloud run deploy --source builds with Cloud Build, stores the image and deploys it in one step.

entries.title: Work that continues after the response is sent
entries.summary: Instance-based billing keeps CPU allocated outside requests, for background work.

entries.title: GPU drivers for a GKE node pool
entries.summary: GKE can install NVIDIA drivers on a GPU node pool automatically with gpu-driver-version.

entries.title: Stopping a streaming pipeline without losing data
entries.summary: Draining a Dataflow job finishes in-flight data before stopping; cancelling drops it.

entries.title: Which databases would not survive a zone failure
entries.summary: Database Center flags fleet-wide issues such as instances without high availability.

entries.title: Running a quick query on a Cloud SQL instance
entries.summary: gcloud sql connect opens a client session to a Cloud SQL instance for ad-hoc SQL.

entries.title: Which rule is blocking this connection
entries.summary: Firewall Rules Logging and Connectivity Tests identify the rule that allows or denies a connection.

entries.title: Adding a partner range to an existing rule
entries.summary: gcloud compute firewall-rules update changes a rule's fields in place; --source-ranges replaces the list.

entries.title: Blocking an attacking address across a whole folder
entries.summary: A deny rule in a hierarchical firewall policy on a folder applies to every VPC beneath it.

entries.title: Cloud VMs resolving on-premises names
entries.summary: A Cloud DNS forwarding zone sends queries for an on-premises domain to on-premises resolvers.

entries.title: On-premises servers resolving a Cloud private zone
entries.summary: An inbound server policy gives on-premises resolvers an address in the VPC to forward queries to.

entries.title: A fixed egress address for a partner's allow-list
entries.summary: Cloud NAT with manually assigned static IP addresses gives private VMs a fixed egress address.

entries.title: Keeping the address a VM already has
entries.summary: An ephemeral external IP can be promoted to a static address without changing it.

entries.title: Isolating two subnets by deleting a route
entries.summary: Subnet routes cannot be deleted or overridden by less specific routes; isolate subnets with firewall rules.

entries.title: Two routes that both match a packet
entries.summary: Route selection prefers the most specific destination prefix before considering priority.

entries.title: Latency percentiles from a value in the logs
entries.summary: A distribution log-based metric extracts a numeric field from log entries into a histogram.

entries.title: Prometheus metrics from an application on a VM
entries.summary: The Ops Agent's Prometheus receiver scrapes an application's /metrics endpoint on a VM.

entries.title: A sink that routes nothing
entries.summary: A sink's writer identity must be granted write access on its destination.

entries.title: One bucket, different teams see different logs
entries.summary: Log views restrict which entries in a log bucket a principal can read.

entries.title: Errors from the last hour, from the command line
entries.summary: gcloud logging read with a filter and --freshness returns recent matching entries.

entries.title: Every log line for one order ID
entries.summary: Structured fields are queried by path, for example jsonPayload.orderId, in Logs Explorer.

entries.title: The Ops Agent is running but sends nothing
entries.summary: A VM's service account needs Logs Writer and Monitoring Metric Writer for the Ops Agent to send data.

entries.title: MySQL metrics from the Ops Agent
entries.summary: The Ops Agent has third-party integrations, such as MySQL, configured as receivers.

entries.title: Turning on managed collection for an existing cluster
entries.summary: Managed Service for Prometheus managed collection is enabled per cluster with --enable-managed-prometheus.

entries.title: Alerting on a PromQL expression
entries.summary: Cloud Monitoring alerting policies accept PromQL conditions over Managed Prometheus data.

entries.title: A commitment sized to steady usage
entries.summary: The committed use discount recommender suggests commitments from observed steady usage.

entries.title: Unattached disks that nobody remembers
entries.summary: Active Assist idle-resource recommendations find unattached persistent disks and estimate the savings.

entries.title: Alert when a heartbeat metric stops arriving
entries.summary: A metric-absence condition fires when a time series stops reporting for a set period.

entries.title: An alert that pages on every brief spike
entries.summary: A longer duration (retest window) on a condition stops brief spikes from opening incidents.

entries.title: One folder's audit logs to a central bucket
entries.summary: An aggregated sink on a folder with --include-children routes logs from every project in the folder.

entries.title: Google incidents across the whole organisation
entries.summary: Personalized Service Health has an organisation-level view of events affecting any project in the org.

entries.title: Cloud Hub shows nothing about the checkout app
entries.summary: Cloud Hub is application-centric: applications must first be defined in App Hub.

entries.title: Memory grows steadily in production
entries.summary: Cloud Profiler's heap profiles show which functions allocate and hold memory in production.

entries.title: Letting an Autopilot Pod use spare CPU above its request
entries.summary: On recent Autopilot clusters, limits above requests let a Pod burst into spare node capacity.

entries.title: An Autopilot workload that must run on Arm nodes
entries.summary: Select Arm with the kubernetes.io/arch: arm64 node selector and an Arm-built image; Autopilot provisions nodes.

entries.title: A specific machine family for one Autopilot workload
entries.summary: Use a compute class (for example Performance) with a machine-family selector instead of node pools.

entries.title: A GPU for one Pod in an Autopilot cluster
entries.summary: In Autopilot, request nvidia.com/gpu in limits and select the GPU type; Autopilot provisions the node.

entries.title: Creating a VM with A100 GPUs
entries.summary: A2 and A3 accelerator-optimized machine types have GPUs built in; choose the machine type, not --accelerator.

entries.title: Starting a Cloud TPU VM for a JAX job
entries.summary: TPU VMs are created with gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create, an accelerator type and a runtime version.

entries.title: Shipping a new version of a deployed agent
entries.summary: Update the existing Agent Runtime resource so its name, sessions and callers' configuration stay the same.

entries.title: An agent staging bucket in a different project
entries.summary: Keep the staging bucket in the agent's project; otherwise grant the platform's service agent read access.

entries.title: A deployed agent that fails on import
entries.summary: Agent Runtime installs only the packages listed in the deployment's requirements.

entries.title: A Workbench instance only one analyst may open
entries.summary: Single-user access mode (--instance-owners) limits the JupyterLab interface to one user.

entries.title: Upgrading a Workbench instance without losing work
entries.summary: An upgrade replaces the boot disk; files on the data disk (/home/jupyter) are kept.

entries.title: Letting a colleague edit a BigQuery Studio notebook
entries.summary: BigQuery notebooks are shared code assets: grant access on the notebook itself.

entries.title: Every workstation with the company's toolchain preinstalled
entries.summary: Extend a Cloud Workstations base image, push it to Artifact Registry and reference it in the configuration.

entries.title: Files that disappear when a workstation restarts
entries.summary: Only /home is on the persistent disk; anything written elsewhere is reset from the image on restart.

entries.title: Letting developers create their own workstations
entries.summary: Grant Cloud Workstations Creator on the configuration; creators get Workstations User on what they create.

entries.title: Which databases have no recent backup
entries.summary: Database Center flags data-protection issues such as missing or stale backups across the fleet.

entries.title: Asking about the database fleet in plain language
entries.summary: Gemini chat in Database Center answers fleet-health questions with project-specific recommendations.

entries.title: Seeing Bigtable and Memorystore in the database fleet view
entries.summary: Database Center covers Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, Bigtable, Firestore, Memorystore and more.

entries.title: Blocking new resources that are not CMEK-protected
entries.summary: The gcp.restrictNonCmekServices organization policy constraint requires CMEK for the listed services.

entries.title: CMEK for every team without creating keys by hand
entries.summary: Cloud KMS Autokey provisions keys on demand in a key project when developers create resources.

entries.title: A CMEK dataset in the EU that will not create
entries.summary: The Cloud KMS key's location must match the resource's location, for example eu for an EU multi-region dataset.

entries.title: Moving a VPC's firewall rules into a network firewall policy
entries.summary: The firewall-rules migrate command builds a global network firewall policy from existing VPC rules.

entries.title: Letting projects decide traffic an org policy should not judge
entries.summary: A hierarchical rule with action goto_next passes evaluation down to lower levels.

entries.title: Seeing which connections a policy rule is matching
entries.summary: Enable logging on the specific firewall policy rule to write Firewall Rules Logging entries.

entries.title: An on-call engineer who cannot see Service Health events
entries.summary: Grant roles/servicehealth.viewer (and enable the Service Health API) for least-privilege access.

entries.title: The Gemini Cloud Assist panel will not work in a new project
entries.summary: Enable the Gemini Cloud Assist API and grant users roles/geminicloudassist.user.

entries.title: Making sense of a latency spike on a dashboard chart
entries.summary: Gemini Cloud Assist can explain a metric chart or log entry in context and suggest next steps.

entries.title: Why an Autopilot HPA scales out too late
entries.summary: HPA CPU utilisation is measured against requests; oversized requests delay scaling and cost more.

entries.title: Several small inference Pods sharing one GPU
entries.summary: GPU time-sharing lets several containers share one physical GPU on a GKE node.

entries.title: Hard isolation between workloads on one A100
entries.summary: Multi-instance GPUs partition an A100/H100 into isolated instances with their own memory and compute.

entries.title: An identity that belongs to one agent only
entries.summary: Agent Identity gives each agent deployed to Agent Runtime its own principal, tied to the agent's lifecycle.

entries.title: Decommissioning an agent completely
entries.summary: Deleting an agent leaves its IAM bindings in place; remove them as part of decommissioning.

entries.title: BigQuery notebook runtimes on a private network
entries.summary: An administrator's runtime template fixes the network, subnet and public-IP setting for notebook runtimes.

entries.title: Collecting diagnostics from a misbehaving Workbench instance
entries.summary: gcloud workbench instances diagnose gathers logs and system data into a bucket for support.

entries.title: Workstations reachable only from the corporate network
entries.summary: A private workstation cluster uses a private gateway reached through Private Service Connect.

entries.title: A GPU in a data scientist's workstation
entries.summary: The workstation configuration specifies the GPU; Cloud Workstations attaches it and installs drivers.

entries.title: Protecting a database from a Cloud Run scale-out
entries.summary: Set maximum instances so a traffic burst cannot open more database connections than the database allows.

entries.title: A node pool upgrade that can be rolled back quickly
entries.summary: Blue-green node pool upgrades keep the old nodes during a soak period so you can roll back.

entries.title: A changed ConfigMap the Pods ignore
entries.summary: Environment variables from a ConfigMap are read at start; restart the Deployment to pick up changes.

entries.title: Scaling workers on a Pub/Sub backlog
entries.summary: An HPA on an external metric such as a subscription's undelivered messages scales queue consumers.

entries.title: Docker Hub rate limits breaking deployments
entries.summary: An Artifact Registry remote repository caches Docker Hub images inside Google Cloud.

entries.title: Snapshots that must stay in Germany
entries.summary: Choose the snapshot storage location (region or multi-region) explicitly to meet residency rules.

entries.title: Every Pending Pod across all namespaces
entries.summary: Use kubectl get pods -A with a field selector on status.phase.

entries.title: Moving old objects onto the new key version
entries.summary: Rotation does not re-encrypt existing data; rewrite objects so they use the new primary version.

entries.title: Undoing a key destruction request
entries.summary: Destroyed key versions stay in 'scheduled for destruction' (30 days by default) and can be restored meanwhile.

entries.title: Backups that ransomware and rogue admins cannot delete
entries.summary: Backup and DR Service backup vaults enforce a minimum retention that nobody can shorten.

entries.title: Reading Spanner data as it was an hour ago
entries.summary: Spanner point-in-time recovery uses version_retention_period (up to 7 days) for stale reads and restores.

entries.title: Joining Cloud SQL rows with BigQuery tables in one query
entries.summary: BigQuery federated queries use EXTERNAL_QUERY through a Cloud SQL connection.

entries.title: Paying for compressed bytes in BigQuery storage
entries.summary: Switching a dataset to the physical storage billing model bills compressed bytes, often far cheaper.

entries.title: Getting back an object deleted three days ago
entries.summary: Soft delete keeps deleted objects for a retention window (7 days by default), even without versioning.

entries.title: Self-managed databases in the fleet view
entries.summary: Database Center also covers databases on Compute Engine VMs, alongside managed services.

entries.title: Sending only one subnet's traffic through an inspection appliance
entries.summary: A policy-based route matches source/destination/protocol and sends matching traffic to an internal LB.

entries.title: A highly available next hop for a static route
entries.summary: Use an internal passthrough Network Load Balancer as next hop to spread across healthy appliances.

entries.title: A peered VPC that cannot see the VPN routes
entries.summary: Export custom routes on one side and import them on the other for peered VPCs to use them.

entries.title: A GKE cluster that has run out of Pod addresses
entries.summary: Add an additional (discontiguous) Pod IPv4 range and use it for new node pools.

entries.title: One address for a global load balancer that must never change
entries.summary: Reserve a global static external IP address and use it in the global forwarding rule.

entries.title: Every firewall rule that actually applies to one VM
entries.summary: get-effective-firewalls shows hierarchical, network-policy and VPC rules applying to an interface.

entries.title: NAT port exhaustion on a few busy VMs
entries.summary: Dynamic port allocation lets busy VMs get more NAT ports while quiet VMs keep few.

entries.title: A cryptic log entry during an incident
entries.summary: Logs Explorer can ask Gemini Cloud Assist to explain a log entry in plain language.

entries.title: Which application's deployment failed last night
entries.summary: Cloud Hub's deployments view shows recent GKE and Cloud Run deployments, including failed App Hub ones.

entries.title: Cost of one application across its projects
entries.summary: Cloud Hub's Optimization page shows cost and utilisation per project or App Hub application.

entries.title: Paging on how fast the error budget is burning
entries.summary: An SLO burn-rate alert pages when the error budget is being consumed too quickly.

entries.title: Testing a multi-step checkout journey every five minutes
entries.summary: Synthetic monitors run scripted tests (such as browser flows) on a schedule and alert on failure.

entries.title: An uptime check for a service with no public address
entries.summary: Private uptime checks reach internal endpoints through Service Directory.

entries.title: Existing Grafana dashboards on Managed Service for Prometheus
entries.summary: Grafana queries Managed Service for Prometheus with PromQL through a Cloud Monitoring data source.

entries.title: OpenTelemetry-instrumented services on Google Cloud
entries.summary: Send OpenTelemetry metrics and traces to Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Trace through an OpenTelemetry Collector.

entries.title: VPC Flow Logs costing more than they are worth
entries.summary: Lower the sampling rate and lengthen the aggregation interval to reduce flow log volume.

entries.title: What TERMINATED means in the instance list
entries.summary: TERMINATED means stopped, not deleted: the VM still exists and its disks and reserved addresses still cost money.

entries.title: Every VM in the organization, not one project
entries.summary: gcloud compute instances list is scoped to one project; Cloud Asset Inventory searches across an organization.

entries.title: Applying a lifecycle configuration from a file
entries.summary: A lifecycle configuration is a bucket-level JSON document, applied with gcloud storage buckets update --lifecycle-file.

entries.title: An age rule that never frees versioned storage
entries.summary: With Object Versioning on, a Delete action on a live object makes it noncurrent; removing old versions needs its own rule.

entries.title: Deleting Coldline objects after a month
entries.summary: Each colder class has a minimum storage duration; deleting early is charged as if the object stayed the full minimum.

entries.title: An inherited role that one project must not have
entries.summary: A child resource cannot remove an allow binding inherited from a parent; change the grant at its source.

entries.title: A Google-managed service agent needs access in another project
entries.summary: Service agents are Google-managed service accounts; when a service reads another project's resource, grant the agent.

entries.title: Deploying a service that runs as a service account
entries.summary: Attaching a service account to a resource requires iam.serviceAccounts.actAs — Service Account User on that account.

entries.title: One Cloud Run service calling another private service
entries.summary: The calling service's attached service account gets a short-lived ID token from the metadata server.

entries.title: Only one repository's pipeline may use the federation
entries.summary: An attribute condition on the workload identity provider restricts which external tokens are accepted.

entries.title: A custom role needed in forty projects
entries.summary: A custom role created in a project can be granted only in that project; create it at the organisation to reuse it.

entries.title: Every binding that applies to a project, including inherited ones
entries.summary: gcloud projects get-ancestors-iam-policy shows the policies of the project and all its ancestors.

entries.title: Granting a Kubernetes service account access directly
entries.summary: Workload Identity Federation for GKE lets you bind IAM roles directly to a Kubernetes service account principal.

entries.title: A least-privilege identity for GKE nodes
entries.summary: Give GKE nodes a minimal custom service account instead of the Editor-bearing default compute account.

entries.title: Retiring a service account you think is unused
entries.summary: Disable a service account first: it is reversible, unlike deletion, and shows whether anything still depends on it.

entries.title: Stop new default service accounts receiving Editor
entries.summary: The iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts constraint stops default service accounts getting Editor.

entries.title: Who is allowed to impersonate a service account
entries.summary: Access to a service account is set on the service account itself as a resource; read its own IAM policy.

entries.title: Running every gcloud command as a service account
entries.summary: gcloud config set auth/impersonate_service_account makes all commands impersonate one service account.

entries.title: Using a federated identity from application code
entries.summary: A WIF credential configuration file tells client libraries how to exchange the external token; it holds no secret.

entries.title: Two scripts editing the same policy at once
entries.summary: set-iam-policy uses the policy's etag, so a concurrent change makes the second write fail instead of overwriting it.

entries.title: Production admin rights only during an incident
entries.summary: Privileged Access Manager grants time-bound, approved, audited elevation on request.

entries.title: A role that applies only to resources tagged env=dev
entries.summary: An IAM condition with resource.matchTag limits a grant to resources carrying a tag value.

entries.title: Network builders who must not touch firewalls
entries.summary: compute.networkAdmin manages networks, subnets and routes but not firewall rules; compute.securityAdmin does firewalls.

entries.title: Calling an IAP-protected app from a script
entries.summary: An OIDC ID token for a service account, minted with the correct audience, authenticates to IAP or Cloud Run.

entries.title: Signed URLs with no key file
entries.summary: A signed URL can be signed through impersonation (signBlob), with no service-account key.

entries.title: An access token that must last eight hours
entries.summary: Access tokens last one hour by default; up to 12 hours needs the credential-lifetime organisation policy.

entries.title: A JWT for a partner API, signed without a key
entries.summary: The IAM Credentials signJwt method signs a JWT with a service account's Google-managed key.

entries.title: A host-network Pod that ignores Workload Identity
entries.summary: Pods that use the host network cannot use Workload Identity Federation for GKE; they see the node's identity.

entries.title: Linking a Kubernetes service account to an IAM service account
entries.summary: Grant roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser to PROJECT.svc.id.goog[NS/KSA] on the IAM SA and annotate the KSA.

entries.title: The same Pod works in one namespace but not another
entries.summary: A Workload Identity principal names the namespace and KSA, so a copy in another namespace is a different principal.

entries.title: Custom node account pulling from another project
entries.summary: A custom node service account needs Artifact Registry Reader on a repository in another project to pull from it.

entries.title: An AWS workload reading from Google Cloud
entries.summary: An AWS provider in a workload identity pool accepts AWS roles, exchanged for short-lived Google tokens.

entries.title: An Azure workload calling Google Cloud
entries.summary: Workloads on Azure federate through an OIDC provider that trusts the Entra ID tenant's issuer.

entries.title: Who may create pools and providers
entries.summary: Workload Identity Pool Admin manages pools and providers; it is separate from using them.

entries.title: On-premises servers with certificates but no IdP
entries.summary: Workload Identity Federation can trust X.509 certificates issued by your own CA.

entries.title: Granting a key role to a service agent that does not exist yet
entries.summary: Force-create a service agent with gcloud beta services identity create before its first use.

entries.title: Restoring a service account deleted last week
entries.summary: A deleted service account can be undeleted within 30 days using its unique ID, keeping its bindings.

entries.title: Renaming a service account
entries.summary: A service account's email (its ID) is permanent; only the display name and description can change.

entries.title: Who acted through a service account
entries.summary: Audit log entries for impersonated calls record the original caller in serviceAccountDelegationInfo.

entries.title: A build trigger that runs as a chosen service account
entries.summary: Choosing a service account for a Cloud Build trigger requires actAs (Service Account User) on it.

entries.title: ID tokens only, not access tokens
entries.summary: roles/iam.serviceAccountOpenIdTokenCreator lets a caller mint OIDC ID tokens but not OAuth access tokens.

entries.title: Managing one service account, not all of them
entries.summary: Roles granted on a single service account resource apply to that account only.

entries.title: Attaching a service account from another project
entries.summary: Attaching a service account from a different project needs actAs and the cross-project usage constraint not enforced.

entries.title: A VM denied despite the right IAM role
entries.summary: Legacy access scopes limit what a VM's service account can do, on top of IAM.

entries.title: Consuming from one subscription only
entries.summary: Grant Pub/Sub Subscriber on the single subscription rather than on the project.

entries.title: A federated pipeline that must act as a service account
entries.summary: Grant roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser on the service account to the federated principal set, then impersonate.

entries.title: Federating a Kubernetes cluster whose issuer is private
entries.summary: Upload the cluster's JWKS to the OIDC provider (--jwk-json-path) when Google cannot fetch the issuer's keys.

entries.title: Keeping a team's identities inside its own projects
entries.summary: Principal access boundary policies limit which resources principals are eligible to access, whatever they are granted.

entries.title: Access only during business hours
entries.summary: An IAM condition on request.time limits when a role binding is effective.

entries.title: Letting a team grant only a few roles
entries.summary: A condition on setIamPolicy using modifiedGrantsByRole limits which roles a delegate may grant.

entries.title: Access to every bucket whose name starts with logs-
entries.summary: An IAM condition on resource.name.startsWith scopes a project-level grant to matching buckets.

entries.title: Reviewing IAM policies across the organisation without data access
entries.summary: Security Reviewer grants permission to list and get IAM policies on all resources, not to read data.

entries.title: An IAM policy that has grown too large
entries.summary: Allow policies have a principal limit (1,500); consolidate individual users into groups.

entries.title: Keeping production and staging pipelines apart
entries.summary: Separate workload identity pools per environment keep federated identities from crossing environments.

entries.title: Stopping an external workload's federation during an incident
entries.summary: Disable the workload identity provider (or pool) to stop new token exchanges immediately.

entries.title: Seeing which external workload made a call
entries.summary: Audit logs record federated principals (and delegation) so external workloads are attributable.

entries.title: Keys that expire on their own
entries.summary: The organisation policy iam.serviceAccountKeyExpiryHours limits the lifetime of new keys.

entries.title: Which keys have not been used for months
entries.summary: Activity Analyzer shows when each service account and key was last used for authentication.

entries.title: An S3-compatible tool that needs Cloud Storage access
entries.summary: Cloud Storage HMAC keys for a service account let S3-compatible tools use the XML API.

entries.title: Cloud Scheduler calling a private Cloud Run service
entries.summary: Cloud Scheduler sends an OIDC token for a service account that has Cloud Run Invoker.

entries.title: Workload Identity Federation on Autopilot
entries.summary: Autopilot clusters have Workload Identity Federation for GKE enabled by default.

entries.title: GitHub Actions cannot get a token for federation
entries.summary: The workflow job needs permissions id-token: write so GitHub issues the OIDC token to exchange.
